question: The playbook targets Java 25 and Spring Boot 4.0+, but the maximum supported upgrade versions are Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.x. Should we proceed with Java 21 / Spring Boot 3.x as an intermediate step?

The playbook prohibits RestTemplate (requires ServiceMesh SDK), SLF4J (requires InternalLogger), and exception-based error handling (requires Result<T> pattern). The codebase uses all three. Should these library migrations be included in this modernization plan?

The assessment report identified hardcoded URLs (http://backend:8080/api in application.yml) and localhost references. Should these be externalized to environment variables or Azure configuration as part of this migration?

The playbook requires Azure AD (OAuth 2.0 / OIDC) for user-facing authentication. The application currently has no explicit authentication mechanism. Should Azure AD integration be added in this plan?
Should deployment to Azure Container Apps be included in this plan, or is containerization readiness (Dockerfile update) sufficient for now?
